data.short_meaning: One who strives or struggles for the sake of Allah
data.long_meaning: The name Muhshin is derived from the Arabic word 'Mushkin', which means 'to make easy or to facilitate'. A Muhshin is someone who strives and struggles in the path of Allah. This name is often given to a child born into a family that values hard work, perseverance, and dedication to their faith. The name Muhshin carries the meaning “One who strives or struggles for the sake of Allah” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Muhshin usually hope their child will grow to embody one who strives or struggles for the sake of allah and live with faith, good character and purpose.
